python3 <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('/Users/nicolastexo/Documents/Rocketory Landingpage/legacy/index.html')
text = path.read_text()
start_blog = text.index('    <section class="rk-section rk-featured rk-featured-focus rk-tone-orange" id="beitrag-im-fokus">')
start_team = text.index('    <section class="rk-page-hero rk-page-hero--dark rk-page-hero--split rk-page-hero--embed" id="ueber-uns"')
start_next = text.index('    <section class="rk-section rk-ag-posts rk-tone-c" id="projekte-preview"')
blog = text[start_blog:start_team]
team = text[start_team:start_next]
new = text[:start_blog] + team + blog + text[start_next:]
path.write_text(new)
print('swapped', len(blog), len(team))
# verify order
idx_b = new.index('id="beitrag-im-fokus"')
idx_u = new.index('id="ueber-uns"')
print('ueber before blog', idx_u < idx_b)
PY
